column1: # p8t5 — the legacy command line, Java vs the port.
# One row per argv shape. Fields are TAB-separated: the first is the row label, every field after
# it is one argv token, verbatim (so a token may contain spaces, which is the point of two of the
# rows). A row with only a label is the EMPTY argv.
# Blank lines and lines whose first character is `#` are ignored by both halves of the driver.
# Deliberately absent: any row whose behaviour depends on a file **existing**. The `-de` arm takes
# an argument verbatim when `new java.io.File(rawArg).exists()` (GlobalSettings.java:571-572) and
# splits it on `+` otherwise, so such a row's answer depends on the working directory the driver
# happens to be launched from, and the transcript would not be portable. That branch is pinned at
